blurb: The Penn CoNLL Corpus of Sumerian is building a complete corpus of Sumerian texts in a version of the CoNLL format (named CoNLL-O) that is used by machine translation systems. The corpus is combined from all Sumerian subcorpora that are available in machine-readable format, leaning heavily on the work of other projects such as CDLI, ETCSL, and ePSD2. PCCS is developed using an augmented form of the (slightly divergent) Oracc/CDLI/eBL standard ATF which is then enriched using Oracc's annotation pipeline. The generated CoNLL-O corpus is intended to be suitable for use both for machine translation and for Universal Dependencies work.
